summary: Verano Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-5 reverse stock split effective June 11, 2026, via a Certificate of Change filed in Nevada. The split reduced issued shares from ~367.7M to ~73.9M and authorized shares from 5B to 1B. No fractional shares were issued; cash payments will be made in lieu thereof using Cboe Canada closing prices. Proportional voting power and percentage ownership remain unchanged except for fractional adjustments. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change.
